In connection with confiscation of two slot
machines from the Cafe "De Luxe" I wish to state the following:
On 16/6/39 I was instructed at Hongkew Police Station to
visit the Japanese Consulate General as there was possibility
that the machines may be returned to me.
On the same day I went to the Consulate and was
received by Mr. Ogawa. Through the Russian interpreter I was
told that the machines would be returned to me on the following
conditions: in writing I must admit that in spite of being
warned three times by the Japanese Authority I continued to
keep the machines on the premises, and allowed the Japanese
soldiers to gamble and that I specially prepared a room
upstairs where the machines were placed for public gambling.
Also I must admit having unlawful possession of the machines
in my premises and to apologize for same.
I was also asked to sign the document in which all
the above mentioned demands were included but I refused and
promised to bring them a letter from me on the following day.
I wrote the letter in which were included only
particulars given by me in my first statement and on 17/6/39
took same to the Japanese Consulate. My letter was found not
satisfactory and was not accepted.
During this visit I was again asked but in a more
persistent form to sign their document but I refused as same
was contradictory to the true facts.
After that I went to the British Consulate General
and reported the occurrence and I was told not to visit the
Japanese Consulate any more.

I again asking for you to order the return of the machines to me. I
also informed you that immediately the machines will be taken by me to
the French Concession.

1939年6月3日

日本方面采取行动
禁止苏州河以北地区
赌博活动

百老汇路茶室两台
老虎机被没收

尽管日军占领的西区“好莱坞”及其他臭名昭著的赌窟仍在大肆营业，但虹口的日本领事警察已决定采取严厉措施，根除当地日本人娱乐活动中的赌博行为。

据昨日《上海每日新闻》报道，日本领事警察根据“内线情报”，于周四上午突袭了位于百老汇路的德吕克斯茶室（De Luxe Tea Room），通过没收两台老虎机，立即执行了其在虹口取缔赌博的决定。报道指出，该茶室由一名俄国人经营。

该报称，此前曾向在其场所内放置此类机器的人员发出过多次警告。报道补充说，这些警告是由日本宪兵队、领事警察以及上海公共租界工部局警务处共同发出的。

该报称，今后不仅将在其场所内放置机器的人会被起诉，被发现参与赌博的日本国民也将被处以重罚。

《每日新闻》继续称，日本领事当局宣称，此类机器的赔付率为1比5。

与此同时，从大光明电影院参观归来、返回虹口的日本人，可能会面临驻守在苏州河桥梁上的日本领事警察的严厉斥责。持有该场所赠券的人必须将赠券交给警察。

SHANGHAI TIMES.

JUN 3 1939

GAMBLING HOUSE IS
RAIDED BY GUNMEN

Big Sum Of Money Taken
From Hollywood Garden
On Yu Yuen Road

Several tens of thousands of
dollars were allegedly carried off
by over 20 armed Chinese from the
Hollywood Garden on Yu Yuen
Road, at about 5 p.m. on Wednes-
day, following a lightning hold-up
which sent hundreds of hapless and
frightened gamblers scuttling for
shelter, according to a Chinese re-
port last night.

The gang was reported to have
brought with them a light-machine
gun, while all the members were
reported to be armed with pistols.
They were said to have walked into
the gambling den as ordinary gam-
blers. Immediately afterwards, they
surrounded the gambling booths,
while many among the gang step-
ped into the gambling rooms and,
at the point of their pistols, there
warned the gambling operators
and the patrons not to move. They
warned them also not to rush out-
side, at the risk of being mowed
down by machine-gun fire.

The gangsters, according to the
report, made good their escape
before the arrival of Ta Tao police.
The report, however, could not be
confirmed from settlement police
who normally do not handle cases
which occur outside the Settlement
areas.

1939年6月3日

持枪歹徒抢劫赌场

豫园路好莱坞花园
巨额现金被劫

据昨晚一份中文报告称，周三下午5时许，20多名武装中国人对豫园路的好莱坞花园实施了闪电式抢劫，劫走数万美元，导致数百名不幸且惊恐的赌客四处逃窜寻求掩护。

据报道，该团伙携带了一挺轻机枪，所有成员均配备手枪。据说他们像普通赌客一样走进赌窟。随即，他们包围了赌台，团伙中的多人进入赌室，用手枪指着赌场经营者和顾客，警告他们不得移动。他们还警告众人不要冲向室外，否则有被机枪扫射的危险。

据报告称，在大道区警察到达之前，歹徒已成功逃脱。然而，这一报告未能得到租界警方的证实，因为租界警方通常不处理发生在租界区域以外的案件。
